name: Darren Russell
title: Professor / Dr, Sexual Health Physician
description: Prism Health is an online gender-affirming healthcare service led by Dr Darren Russell, practising the informed consent model. Dr Darren is an expert in hormonal treatment for transgender people, including both adults and adolescents, and practises gender affirming care in accordance with the 2024 AusPATH Australian Informed Consent Standards of Care; psychiatric assessment is not required if you are over 18. He moved back to Victoria to open Prism Health as a telehealth service.
specialties: gender affirming hormone therapy, adolescent gender care, HIV, sexual health, PrEP, medical abortion

name: Michelle Dutton
title: Dr, GP
description: Michelle has worked as a GP with the Trans and Gender Diverse community since 2014, including over 10 years at Northside Clinic, and at Equinox and Your Community Health. She currently works part time with the Orygen/headspace Trans and Gender Diverse team. Prism Health is an online-only gender-affirming service using the informed consent model.
specialties: gender affirming hormone therapy, trans and gender diverse primary care

name: Catherine Lyons
title: Dr, GP
description: Dr Catherine has a special interest in gender affirming care. She is deeply passionate about supporting people to be their true selves and being able to express their gender, sexuality and personal identity as authentically as possible. Her care is inclusive of all neurotypes, identities and body types. Prism Health is an online-only gender-affirming service using the informed consent model.
specialties: gender affirming care, sexual health, general practice

name: Danielle Stefanski
title: Dr, Infectious Diseases & General Physician
description: Infectious diseases and general physician based in Naarm/Melbourne. Danielle looks forward to providing a service in chronic disease management for trans and gender diverse patients, where she can be their physician who understands the trans experience. A referral from a GP or specialist is needed for Medicare rebates.
specialties: trans and gender diverse chronic disease management, HIV, hepatitis, infectious diseases
identity: "Danielle came out publicly as transgender in 2022"

name: Ada Cheung
title: Professor, Endocrinologist
practice: Private rooms at North Eastern Urology
description: Specialist endocrinologist whose listed conditions treated include Trans and Gender Diverse Health; her research focuses on improving health outcomes for trans and gender diverse individuals. Consultations are available face-to-face and via secure video, and she offers telehealth Australia-wide. GP referral required; she also works in the bulk-billed Austin Health Transgender Clinic.
specialties: trans and gender diverse health, endocrinology, testosterone and oestrogen therapy

name: Kateena Vogel
title: Dr, GP
description: She is committed to providing a safe and inclusive space regardless of gender identity or sexual orientation, and is an AusPATH member who has committed to working to strengthen the health, rights and wellbeing of binary and non binary trans people. Wellness on Wellington provides gender affirming healthcare including access to hormone therapy and referrals to appropriate specialists.
specialties: gender affirming care, preventative health, chronic disease, child health
